Details worth knowing

About this piece

CJ lists this supplement as 60 capsules. The supplied label artwork names Ashwagandha root and black pepper, with pullulan capsules as the inactive ingredient. The exact batch is confirmed before an order is invoiced.

View the original CJ listing (opens in a new tab)
Listing reference

ASHWAGANDHA WITH BLACK PEPPER

Listing text supplied by the owner on 6 November 2026 and checked against the supplied label artwork. The physical pack and batch are confirmed before invoicing.

Product form
Capsules, according to the listing description and supplied label. CJ's separate 'Powder' attribute conflicts with this description.
Pack quantity
60 capsules (listing and label-stated)
Label serving size
2 capsules; 30 servings per container. These are label details, not an OPAR dosing recommendation.
Ashwagandha per label serving
1,300 mg Withania somnifera root per 2 capsules (label-stated; not independently tested)
Black pepper per label serving
10 mg Piper nigrum fruit per 2 capsules (label-stated; not independently tested)
Inactive ingredient
Pullulan capsules (label-stated)
Gross package weight
0.25 lb / 113 g (supplier-stated); this is not net powder weight
Manufacturing country
USA (supplier-stated; batch traceability confirmed before invoicing)
Supplier SKU
CJHP232030301AZ
Documents
One supplied label-artwork PDF reviewed. Batch laboratory reports are requested with each order.
